title: Skin results
caption: Skin cells renew in cycles — roughly 28 days in younger skin, longer as you age — which means almost every ingredient or treatment is working on a timeline you can't see yet. Collagen takes weeks to rebuild. Pigmentation moves up through layers before it clears. This is biology, not the product failing. Knowing the cycle length for your specific concern tells you when to genuinely evaluate whether something is working — and when you're just in the waiting period. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
